title: Formic Raises $50M to Scale Physical AI in U.S. Factories
summary:
The provider of robots-as-a-service for manufacturers has secured a $40M Series B round and $10M in asset-backed financing to expand its industrial footprint. Chicago-based Formic will use the $50M in new capital to deploy physical AI on factory floors to streamline automation for its clients.

Formic currently operates in more than 100 U.S. manufacturing facilities across 30 states, maintaining 99.6% uptime and a 97% renewal rate. Initialized, which led the company's seed round in 2021, remains an investor as the team led by Saman Farid scales these operations.
